defendant: BRIAN J. JUDGE AND TRACI JUDGE, HUSBAND AND WIFE; TOWNSHIP OF DEPTFORD; COUNTY OF GLOUCESTER; GLOUCESTER COUNTY DEPARTMENT OF ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT; MEYNER AND LANDIS LLP AND LVNV FUNDING LLC, SUCCESSOR IN INTEREST CREDIT ONE BANK, N.A.
description:
PUBLIC NOTICE
SHERIFF’S SALE
SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
CHANCERY DIVISION,
GLOUCESTER COUNTY
DOCKET NO.: F-003151-25
SHERIFF’S NO.: 26001003
Plaintiff:
M&T BANK
Vs
Defendant:
BRIAN J. JUDGE AND TRACI JUDGE, HUSBAND AND WIFE; TOWNSHIP OF DEPTFORD; COUNTY OF GLOUCESTER; GLOUCESTER COUNTY DEPARTMENT OF ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT; MEYNER AND LANDIS LLP AND LVNV FUNDING LLC, SUCCESSOR IN INTEREST CREDIT ONE BANK, N.A.
By virtue of the above stated Pluries Writ of Execution to me directed and delivered, issued out of the above stated Court, will be exposed for sale at Public Venue, on Wednesday, September 2, 2026, to-wit, at 2 o’clock in the afternoon prevailing time, at 1 N. Broad Street, Ceremonial Courtroom 201 in the City of Woodbury, County of Gloucester and State of New Jersey, all the following described real estate, that is to say:
Property being known as: 1093 BYRD DRIVE WOODBURY, NJ 08096 and BLOCK 194, LOT 14
MUNICIPALITY: TOWNSHIP OF DEPTFORD
APPROXIMATE DIMENSIONS: 100.00 x 150.00 FEET
NEAREST CROSS STREET: ELI PLACE
SUBJECT TO:
WATER - TO: 05/27/2026 $28.10 OPEN AND DUE 07/01/2026
SEWER - 06/01/2026 - 06/30/2026 $41.00 OPEN AND DUE 07/01/2026
UPSET PRICE: $147,646.85
OCCUPANCY STATUS: OCCUPIED
The Sheriff hereby reserves the right to adjourn the sale without further notice through publication.
The approximate amount of the Judgment sought to be satisfied by said sale is $127,666.32
The purchaser must pay 20% of the purchase price in cash, certified check, cashier’s check, or treasurer’s check, balance to be paid within 30 days.
A deed to be delivered to the purchaser within 30 days from the date of sale, with lawful interest on the balance due, from the 11th day after sale, until the balance is paid.
Any eligible defendant/party interested in purchasing this property through the NJ Community Wealth Preservation Program set forth in NJ A5664 can find more information on our website at https://www.gloucestercountynj.gov/564/Foreclosure-Procedures.
Sales will begin promptly at 2:00pm. Please arrive shortly before this time to check in if you plan on bidding.
SURPLUS MONEY: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any persons claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person’s claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
Seized as the property of the Defendant, and taken in execution at the suit of the Plaintiff, and to be sold by
Carmel M. Morina,
Gloucester County Sheriff
Advertised online at: https://salesweb.civilview.com/Sales/SalesSearch?countyId=19
Date: July 10, 2026
Firm: MCCALLA RAYMER LEIBERT PIERCE, LLC
Judgement Date: 7/10/2026
